search_window.basis: Start is the completed_at of the previous verified Care Line Watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; end is this run's observation completion.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; the national Care Line production collector and editorial review queue remain authoritative.
coverage_notes.scope: U.S., DC and territories; hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary care loss, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance and air-medical suspension/closure, CMS regulatory notices, and effective restoration of previously lost essential services.

cms_public_notices.details: Official CMS Public Notices page opened directly; top entries remain October 23 HHA terminations. No new termination, rescission or CLIA limitation/suspension in observation window.

targeted_queries: "cancer center" OR "oncology clinic" closes services October 26 2026
site:gov "October 26, 2026" hospital closure emergency department reopening
"Puerto Rico" OR Guam OR "Virgin Islands" hospital clinic emergency services closure October 2026
coverage_notes.screening: No new verified and concretely effective U.S. or territory healthcare-access change surfaced since the previous heartbeat; the strongest current-looking links concern proposed future changes, events already reported earlier, non-U.S. services, or historical service losses.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted searches are a bounded recall pass rather than exhaustive surveillance; search indexing and published timestamps can lag; zero findings is not proof that no access change occurred.
coverage_notes.controls: One private heartbeat only. No approval, publication, schedule alteration, automation disabling or production changes.
